column1: # What "absent from the exclusion group" is worth when the group is small.
# CC7's 47 inclusion genomes against nested exclusion groups sampled (seed 42) from its own 716. Every
# marked run of 40 bases or more that a run reported was then blasted against ALL 716 at -evalue 1: a
# stretch the full set holds at half its length or more was absent only from the group that was given.
# false   the full set holds it: true of the group given, not of the species
# real    nothing in any of the 716 genomes at evalue 1
# weak    a partial hit only (one 8 kb stretch, 20-21% covered at 88-89%)
